description: The line plot illustrates the performance of three different reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms—On-policy RL, LUFY, and SFT—across various temperatures. The x-axis, labeled "Temperature," is on a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (Passes)," spans from 65.0 to 80.0, with tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The On-policy RL line, marked with a solid line and star markers, shows a generally increasing trend in performance as the temperature increases, starting at approximately 75.0 and peaking at around 80.0. The LUFY line, indicated by a dashed line and triangle markers, exhibits a fluctuating performance, with values ranging from about 70.0 to 77.5. The SFT line, represented by a solid line with square markers, also shows variability, with performance values oscillating between roughly 70.0 and 77.5. The plot does not include any inferred data points or conclusions about the cause of the changes in performance.
